# EnhancedPets 1.3.0

This release includes the completed pet-management work plus a large pass of bug fixes and data-integrity improvements.

## Highlights

- **Configurable revive item** — set `revive-item` to any material (`DIRT`, `NETHERITE_SCRAP`, etc.), with configurable amount and main-hand requirement.
- **Automatic config migration** — new options are added to existing `config.yml` files without removing your edits or comments.
- **Pet names with spaces** — names now support spaces and Unicode letters, with a 32-character limit.
- **Multilingual support** — set `language-file` to use a translated copy of `language.yml`; missing keys fall back to English.
- **Happy Ghast safety** — Happy Ghasts can no longer be used as fireball launchers.

## Bug fixes

- Fixed pet record duplication/ghost records when freeing, reviving, withdrawing, or transferring pets whose owner is offline.
- Fixed unmanaged pet deaths being overwritten by the next autosave.
- Fixed pet ownership not being reconciled after transferring an unloaded pet.
- Fixed UTF-8 handling for player pet data and dried-ghast tracking data.
- Fixed atomic pet-ID allocation.
- Fixed null max-health attribute crashes across GUI, healing, metadata, and damage notifications.
- Fixed GUI item duplication via double-click collection.
- Fixed storing an unloaded pet leaving a duplicate entity behind.
- Fixed revive consuming the item when spawning failed.
- Fixed the empty main menu hiding the Scan and Batch buttons.
- Fixed empty batch-selection and cross-world targeting crashes.
- Fixed station/target mutual exclusion and station-radius validation.
- Fixed dried-ghast storage save races and unnecessary chunk loading.
- Fixed cat variants not showing in pet lore.

## Upgrade notes

- Place `enhancedpets-1.3.0.jar` in your `plugins/` folder.
- Existing `config.yml` and `language.yml` files are migrated automatically on startup.
- Requires Java 17+ and a Paper-compatible server (1.17–1.21.x).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/AxoIsAxo/EnhancedPets/compare/1.1.0...1.3.0
